deviations_from_reference: Synthetic 9-frame sequence vs upstream's 100+ frame collections.
Cascade 86-element row-0 virtual array → azimuth FFT-128 → drop bin 0 → fftshift → Na=127 (matches mm3DGS-v6/v7 RA).
Custom DART antenna gain `cascade_az127` added via patches/cascade_az127.patch (mirrors awr1843boost_az8 for an 86-element half-lambda array).
Doppler axis: 16 chirps → 16 bins (vs upstream Boreas 256). PLAN Section 9(a) flagged this; ego speed 1.3-1.6 m/s gives non-zero psi_min weights.
Doppler axis labeled ±5 m/s; true cascade d_max requires chirp PRI not in our config files. Documented limitation.
Per-scene normalisation: 99th percentile of train RDA cubes.
--pval=0.15 (vs 0 in upstream PLAN); ensures non-empty val for small training sets.
Training epochs: 300 (PLAN Section 8 default 3); 8 frames × Nd valid columns / batch is small, so we run more epochs to give the HashGrid + plenoctree NN time to settle.
